operating_principles: Local-first and free-tier-first; no paid dependency without Chairman approval.
Workers receive least-privilege access scoped to assigned tasks.
Every consequential action records actor, input references, output, timestamp, and approval.
Workers may research, draft, classify, monitor, reconcile, and recommend within their assigned scope.
Publishing, payments, refunds, supplier commitments, purchase orders, live pricing changes, and external campaigns require explicit authorized approval.
No worker may invent inventory, testing, certifications, warranty coverage, manufacturer statements, or customer reviews.
